content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Relaxations in marks apply to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes (Non-creamy Layer), and Differently abled categories as per UGC regulations. A relaxation of 5% is also provided to Ph.D. degree holders who obtained their Master's degree prior to 19 September 1991.

rows.qualification: A Master’s degree with 55% marks in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university, along with NET, SLET, SET, or a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC Regulations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The honorarium for Guest Faculty is Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month. Guest faculty are not entitled to allowances, pension, gratuity, and leave admissible to regular teachers. No claim for regularisation or contract extension will be entertained, and superannuated teachers may be considered up to the age of 70 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNU Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Go to the official website at http://jnu.ac.in/career. Access the online application link available on the portal. Submit the application online through CU-CHAYAN. Upload a photograph, scanned copies of all certificates, marksheets, teaching and research evidence, NOC from employer, Master, M.Phil, Ph.D, NET certificates, published article reprints, date of birth certificate, and caste certificate. Complete the online submission between 12 October 2026 (04:00 PM) and 26 October 2026 (5:00 PM).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Photograph Scanned signatures Certificates and marksheets of educational qualifications (Master, M.Phil, Ph.D) NET / SLET / SET certificate Evidence of teaching and research NOC from the employer Reprints of published articles Certificate containing date of birth record Caste certificate (if applicable)

faq.question: Q1. Is this JNU Guest Faculty position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: These positions are engaged on a contract basis for the Monsoon Semester 2026 with no claim for regularisation.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for a relaxation in marks?
faq.answer: A relaxation of 5% in marks at the Bachelor's and Master's levels is allowed for candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes (Non-creamy Layer), and Differently abled categories, as well as Ph.D. degree holders who completed their Master's prior to 19 September 1991.

faq.question: Q3. Can superannuated teachers apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, superannuated teachers may be considered for engagement as Guest Faculty subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates for the interview is based on the academic score specified in Appendix II (Table 3A) for Universities of UGC Regulations, 2018, and selections are based solely on interview performance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the deadline to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 26 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.
